def NesterovSharpThreshold.UniversalBoundedness : ℝ → Prop :=
fun r =>
  ∀ (F : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert → ℝ) (G : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert → ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert)
    (X V : ℝ → ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert),
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
      (∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), HasGradientAt F (G x) x) →
        LipschitzWith 1 G →
          (∃ z, ∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), F z ≤ F x) →
            Continuous X →
              Continuous V →
                V 0 = 0 →
                  (∀ t ≥ 0, HasDerivAt X (V t) t) →
                    (∀ t > 0, HasDerivAt V (-(r / t) • V t - G (X t)) t) → ∃ C, ∀ t ≥ 0, ‖X t‖ ≤ C
NesterovSharpThreshold.exists_subcritical_norm_divergent_flow {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) (hr3 : r < 3) :
  ∃ F G X V,
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F ∧
      (∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), HasGradientAt F (G x) x) ∧
        LipschitzWith 1 G ∧
          (∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), ‖G x‖ ≤ 2) ∧
            F 0 = 0 ∧
              (∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), 0 ≤ F x) ∧
                Continuous X ∧
                  Continuous V ∧
                    X 0 = NesterovHilbert.initialData (NesterovThresholdModel.point 2 1) ∧
                      V 0 = 0 ∧
                        (∀ t ≥ 0, HasDerivAt X (V t) t) ∧
                          (∀ t > 0, HasDerivAt V (-(r / t) • V t - G (X t)) t) ∧
                            Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ‖X t‖) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
NesterovSharpThreshold.sharp_boundedness_threshold {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) :
  NesterovSharpThreshold.UniversalBoundedness r ↔ 3 ≤ r

NesterovHighDamping.bounded_distance.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E] {r : ℝ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) {f : E → ℝ} {g : E → E} (hc : ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f)

def DiscreteNesterov.UniversalDiscreteBoundedness : ℝ → Prop :=
fun r =>
  ∀ (F : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert → ℝ) (G : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert → ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert)
    (b : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert),
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ F →
      (∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), HasGradientAt F (G x) x) →
        LipschitzWith 1 G →
          (∃ z, ∀ (x : ↥NesterovHilbert.Hilbert), F z ≤ F x) → ∃ C, ∀ (k : ℕ), ‖DiscreteNesterov.nagX r 1 G b k‖ ≤ C
def DiscreteNesterov.nagState.{u_1} : {E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst : NormedSpace ℝ E] → ℝ → ℝ → (E → E) → E → ℕ → E × E :=
fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] r h G b x =>
  Nat.brecOn x fun x f =>
    (match (motive := (x : ℕ) → Nat.below x → E × E) x with
      | 0 => fun x => (b, b)
      | k.succ => fun x =>
        let old := x.1;
        let x := old.2 - h ^ 2 • G old.2;
        (x, x + DiscreteNesterov.momentum r k • (x - old.1)))
      f
DiscreteNesterov.sharp_discrete_boundedness_threshold {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
  DiscreteNesterov.UniversalDiscreteBoundedness r ↔ 3 ≤ r

NesterovPlanar.planar_valley_escape {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 < r) (hr2 : r ≤ 2) :

        (∀ (z : NesterovModel.Plane), HasGradientAt NesterovModel.potential (NesterovModel.gradient z) z) ∧
          LipschitzWith 1 NesterovModel.gradient ∧

              (∀ (z : NesterovModel.Plane), NesterovModel.potential z = 0 ↔ z 1 = 0 ∧ 1 ≤ z 0) ∧
                ∃ q u,

                        u 0 = 0 ∧

                              (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → HasDerivAt u (-(r / t) • u t - NesterovModel.gradient (q t)) t) ∧
                                Filter.Tendsto (fun t => q t 0) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧
                                  Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ‖q t‖) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
